summary: VitalOrbit – Astronaut Health Monitoring Software for Space Missions is a software concept designed to monitor and visualize astronauts' health conditions during space missions. It provides a centralized dashboard to track important health indicators such as heart rate, blood oxygen (SpO₂), core body temperature, stress levels and hydration estimates. The system includes individual astronaut profiles, graphical health trends and an overall crew wellness overview. Its main objective is to support astronaut health awareness, help mission teams observe changes in health indicators and improve crew wellness monitoring in space. The prototype features a user-friendly interface with mission selection and monitoring controls. In the future, it aims to integrate validated health sensor data and relevant space-agency datasets to enhance monitoring capabilities and support better health management during long-duration space missions.

Project Description

VitalOrbit – Astronaut Health Monitoring Software for Space Missions

VitalOrbit is a software-based concept designed to monitor and visualize astronauts' health conditions during space missions. It provides a centralized dashboard to track important health indicators, including heart rate, blood oxygen (SpO₂), body temperature, stress levels and hydration estimates.

The platform features individual astronaut profiles, graphical health trends and a crew wellness overview. Its goal is to help mission teams observe health changes and support astronaut well-being during long-duration space missions.

The current prototype uses simulated health readings and is designed for future integration with validated health sensor data and relevant NASA research datasets.

Team: The Creative Thinkers

Developer/Presenter: Aswin B.
